subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: On reaching his house the child said, "Hurrah! Finally, I am at my hosue." He said to the old man." Thank you for your kind help. May God bless you with good health and long life!" The old man said," Good bye! Child," and went away.
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech On reaching his house the child exclaimed with joy that he was finally at his house. Then he (c) thanked him (man) for his (man) kind help. The child also prayed for him (man) that God might bless him (man) with good health and long life. The old man bade the child goodbye and had gone away.
